# DR. Mortgage USA

> DR. Mortgage USA is the professional mortgage education and guidance website of Dennis Ross, a Navy veteran and Florida Mortgage Loan Originator serving Greater Orlando and clients across Florida through Home 1st Lending, LLC.

Canonical website: https://drmortgageusa.com/

## Entity disambiguation

DR. Mortgage USA on drmortgageusa.com is the professional brand and educational website of Dennis Ross, individual NMLS 2018381. Dennis originates mortgage loans through Home 1st Lending, LLC, company NMLS 1418. DR. Mortgage USA is not a separate lender or mortgage company and does not refer to Dr. Mortgage, LLC or another similarly named mortgage company.

## Primary expertise and service area

Dennis Ross provides mortgage education, planning, and loan-origination support for VA home loans, first-time homebuyers, FHA and conventional loans, down payment assistance, refinancing, HELOCs, self-employed borrowers, and property investors. His strongest geographic focus is Greater Orlando and Central Florida, including Orlando, Lake Mary, Winter Park, Sanford, Altamonte Springs, and Oviedo. Florida is the licensed service state described on this website.

## Core pages

- [VA loans in Greater Orlando](https://drmortgageusa.com/va-loans-orlando): VA eligibility, zero-down possibilities, entitlement, appraisals, condos, repeat use, and benefit-focused planning for veterans, active-duty service members, and eligible military families.
- [Orlando mortgage broker](https://drmortgageusa.com/orlando-mortgage-broker): Local mortgage planning and product comparisons for Greater Orlando buyers and homeowners.
- [First-time homebuyer guidance](https://drmortgageusa.com/first-time-homebuyer-orlando): Orlando-focused preparation, affordability, and loan-option guidance.
- [Florida refinancing](https://drmortgageusa.com/refinance-florida): Rate-and-term and cash-flow refinance planning for Florida homeowners.
- [HELOC guidance](https://drmortgageusa.com/heloc-orlando): Home-equity line of credit education and planning.
- [Down payment assistance](https://drmortgageusa.com/down-payment-assistance): Florida and Orlando-area assistance-program guidance.
- [Mortgage options](https://drmortgageusa.com/mortgage-options): Overview of loan programs and common use cases.
- [Mortgage resources](https://drmortgageusa.com/resources): Educational guides and planning tools.
- [Mortgage FAQ](https://drmortgageusa.com/faq): Plain-language answers to common mortgage questions.
- [Contact Dennis Ross](https://drmortgageusa.com/contact): Direct contact and appointment options.

## Selected VA loan resources

- [Florida VA loan guide](https://drmortgageusa.com/blog/va-loan-guide-florida-veterans-2026): Overview of VA loan benefits, eligibility, entitlement, and purchase planning.
- [VA loan versus conventional loan in Orlando](https://drmortgageusa.com/blog/va-loan-vs-conventional-orlando-2026): Comparison of common tradeoffs for eligible Orlando buyers.
- [VA funding fee guide](https://drmortgageusa.com/blog/va-funding-fee-guide-2026): Funding-fee basics and exemption considerations.
- [VA appraisal and repair guidance](https://drmortgageusa.com/blog/va-appraisal-repairs-florida-2026): Florida appraisal, minimum property, and repair considerations.
- [VA residual income guidance](https://drmortgageusa.com/blog/va-residual-income-florida-veterans-2026): How residual-income review fits VA qualification.
- [VA loan entitlement and repeat use](https://drmortgageusa.com/blog/va-loan-entitlement-more-than-once-florida): Entitlement restoration and using a VA benefit more than once.
- [VA IRRRL streamline refinance](https://drmortgageusa.com/blog/irrrl-va-streamline-refinance-florida-2026): Florida-focused overview of the VA streamline refinance option.
